items.name: parse_string_to_decimal_native
items.signature: fn parse_string_to_decimal_native<T: DecimalType>(value_str: &str, scale: usize) -> Result<T::Native, ArrowError> where T::Native: DecimalCast + ArrowNativeTypeOp
items.summary: Parses given string to specified decimal native (i128/i256) based on given scale. Returns an `Err` if it cannot parse given string.

items.name: rescale_decimal
items.signature: fn rescale_decimal<I: DecimalType, O: DecimalType>(value: I::Native, input_precision: u8, input_scale: i8, output_precision: u8, output_scale: i8) -> Option<O::Native> where I::Native: DecimalCast + ArrowNativeTypeOp, O::Native: DecimalCast + ArrowNativeTypeOp
items.summary: Rescales a decimal value from `(input_precision, input_scale)` to `(output_precision, output_scale)` and returns the converted number when it fits within the output precision.

items.name: single_float_to_decimal
items.signature: fn single_float_to_decimal<D>(input: f64, mul: f64) -> Option<D::Native> where D: DecimalType + ArrowPrimitiveType, <D as ArrowPrimitiveType>::Native: DecimalCast
items.summary: Cast a single floating point value to a decimal native with the given multiple. Returns `None` if the value cannot be represented with the requested precision.
